diagnostics.message: google_compute_organization_security_policy_association.attachment sets policy_id from var.firewall_policy_attachments (policy_id = each.value) rather than from google_compute_organization_security_policy.policy, so Terraform cannot infer that the association must be created after the policy. When an attachment references a policy created by this module, the apply may fail because the policy does not yet exist. The association should depend on google_compute_organization_security_policy.policy (e.g. explicit depends_on), since no clean data reference is available (attachment keys don't correspond to the policy map keys).
